Agra.name: Agra
Agra.title: Agra
Agra.description: Agra (; Hindi: Āgarā, pronounced [ˈaːɡɾaː] ) is a city on the banks of the Yamuna river in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is a part of Western Uttar Pradesh, about 230 kilometres (140 mi) south-east of the national capital Delhi and 330 km west of the state capital Lucknow.
Agra.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ajmer.name: Ajmer
Ajmer.title: Ajmer
Ajmer.description: Ajmer (pronounced [əd͡ʑ.meːɾ] ) is a city in the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan. It serves as the administrative headquarters of the Ajmer district and Ajmer division.
Ajmer.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Alappuzha.name: Alappuzha
Alappuzha.title: Alappuzha
Alappuzha.description: Alappuzha (Malayalam: [aːlɐpːuɻɐ] ) or Alleppey is a city and municipality on the Laccadive Sea in the southern Indian state of Kerala. It is the headquarters of Alappuzha district, located about 62 km (39 mi) south of the commercial city of Kochi and 152 km (94.4 mi) northwest of the state capital Thiruvananthapuram.
Alappuzha.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Alwar.name: Alwar
Alwar.title: Alwar
Alwar.description: Alwar (Rajasthani Pronunciation: [əlʋəɾ]) is a city in Rajasthan and the administrative headquarters of Alwar District in the state of Rajasthan. It is located 150 km south of Delhi and 150 km north of Jaipur.
Alwar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Amritsar.name: Amritsar
Amritsar.title: Amritsar
Amritsar.description: Amritsar, also known as Ambarsar, is the second-largest city in the Indian state of Punjab, after Ludhiana. Located in the Majha region, it is a major cultural, transportation and economic centre.
Amritsar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Anandpur Sahib.name: Anandpur Sahib
Anandpur Sahib.title: Anandpur Sahib
Anandpur Sahib.description: Anandpur Sahib, also referred simply as Anandpur (lit. 'city of bliss'), is a city in Rupnagar district (Ropar), on the edge of Shivalik Hills, in the Indian state of Punjab.
Anandpur Sahib.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ayodhya.name: Ayodhya
Ayodhya.title: Ayodhya
Ayodhya.description: Ayodhya (Hindi: Ayodhyā, pronounced [ɐˈjoːd̪ʱjɐː] ) is a city situated on the banks of the Sarayu river in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is the administrative headquarters of the Ayodhya district as well as the Ayodhya division of Uttar Pradesh, India.
Ayodhya.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Badami.name: Badami
Badami.title: Badami
Badami.description: Bādāmi (Kannada: [baːd̪aːmi]), formerly known as Vātāpi (Sanskrit: from āpi, ‘friend, ally’; ‘having the wind (vāta) as an ally’), is a town and headquarters of a taluk by the same name, in the Bagalkot district of Karnataka, India. It was the regal capital of the Badami Chalukyas from 540 to 757.
Badami.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bengaluru.name: Bengaluru
Bengaluru.title: Bengaluru
Bengaluru.description: Bengaluru, also known as Bangalore (its official name until 1 November 2014), is the capital and largest city of the southern Indian state of Karnataka. As per the 2011 census, the city had a population of 8.4 million, making it the third most populous city in India and the most populous in South India.
Bengaluru.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chandigarh.name: Chandigarh
Chandigarh.title: Chandigarh
Chandigarh.description: Chandigarh is a city and union territory in northwestern India, serving as a shared capital for the states of Punjab and Haryana. Situated near the foothills of the Shivalik range of Himalayas, it borders Haryana to the east and Punjab in the remaining directions.
Chandigarh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chennai.name: Chennai
Chennai.title: Chennai
Chennai.description: Chennai, also known as Madras, is the capital and largest city of Tamil Nadu, the southernmost state of India. It is located on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal.
Chennai.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Chennai.imageCredit: jamal haider from india · CC BY-SA 2.0

Chidambaram.name: Chidambaram
Chidambaram.title: Chidambaram
Chidambaram.description: Chidambaram (Thillai) is a major town and municipality in Cuddalore district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu, on the banks of the Vellar River where it meets the Bay of Bengal. It is the headquarters of the Chidambaram taluk.
Chidambaram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chittorgarh.name: Chittorgarh
Chittorgarh.title: Chittorgarh
Chittorgarh.description: Chittorgarh (Hindi pronunciation: [t͡ʃɪt̪ːɔːɽ.gəɽʱ] ; also Chitror, Chittor or Chittaurgarh) is a major city in the state of Rajasthan in western India. It lies on the Berach River, a tributary of the Banas, and is the administrative headquarters of Chittorgarh District.
Chittorgarh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Coimbatore.name: Coimbatore
Coimbatore.title: Coimbatore
Coimbatore.description: Coimbatore (Tamil: Kōyamputtūr, IPA: [koːjɐmbut̪ːuːɾ] ), also known as Kovai (IPA: [koːʋaj] ), is a metropolitan city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located on the banks of the Noyyal River and surrounded by the Western Ghats.
Coimbatore.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Coonoor.name: Coonoor
Coonoor.title: Coonoor
Coonoor.description: Coonoor or Kunnur (Tamil: [kunːuːr] ), is a taluk and a municipal town of the Nilgiris District in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. As of 2011, the town had a population of 45,494.
Coonoor.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Dehradun.name: Dehradun
Dehradun.title: Dehradun
Dehradun.description: Dehradun (Hindi: Dēhrādūn, pronounced [ˈd̪ɛɦɾaːd̪uːn]), also known as Dehra Doon ( DAIR-ə DOON) is the Winter capital and most populous city of the Indian state of Uttarakhand. It is the administrative headquarters of Dehradun district.
Dehradun.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Delhi.name: Delhi
Delhi.title: Delhi
Delhi.description: Delhi, officially the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi, is a megacity and a union territory of India containing New Delhi, the capital of India. Straddling the Yamuna river, but spread chiefly to the west, or beyond its right bank, Delhi shares borders with the state of Uttar Pradesh in the east and with the state of Haryana in the remaining directions.
Delhi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Devprayag.name: Devprayag
Devprayag.title: Devprayag
Devprayag.description: Devprayag  (Deva prayāga) is a town and a nagar palika, near New Tehri city in Tehri Garhwal District in the state of Uttarakhand, India, and is the final one of the Panch Prayag (five confluences) of Alaknanda River where Alaknanda meets the Bhagirathi river and both rivers thereafter flow on as the Ganges river or Ganga.
Devprayag.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Dharamshala.name: Dharamshala
Dharamshala.title: Dharamshala
Dharamshala.description: Dharamshala (, Hindi: [d̪ʱərmʃaːlaː]; also spelled Dharamsala) is a town in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It serves as the winter capital of the state and the administrative headquarters of the Kangra district since 1855.
Dharamshala.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Fatehpur Sikri.name: Fatehpur Sikri
Fatehpur Sikri.title: Fatehpur Sikri
Fatehpur Sikri.description: Fatehpur Sikri (Hindi: [ˈfətɛɦpʊɾ ˈsiːkɾiː]) is a town in the Agra District of Uttar Pradesh, India. Situated 35.7 kilometres (22.2 mi) from the district headquarters of Agra, Fatehpur Sikri itself was founded as the capital of the Mughal Empire in 1571 by Emperor Akbar, serving this role from 1571 to 1585, when Akbar abandoned it due to a campaign in Punjab and was later completely abandoned in 1610.
Fatehpur Sikri.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Gulmarg.name: Gulmarg
Gulmarg.title: Gulmarg
Gulmarg.description: Gulmarg (also known as Gulmarag, lit. 'meadow of flowers' in Kashmiri) is a hill station and a notified area committee in Baramulla district of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
Gulmarg.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Guruvayur.name: Guruvayur
Guruvayur.title: Guruvayur
Guruvayur.description: Guruvayur IPA: [guɾuʋɐːjuːr]) is a municipal temple town in Thrissur district, of Kerala State in India. It is a suburban town of Thrissur city, located 26 kilometres (16 mi) from Thrissur towards the north-west.
Guruvayur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Hampi.name: Hampi
Hampi.title: Hampi
Hampi.description: Hampi or Hampe (Kannada: [hɐmpe]), also referred to as the Group of Monuments at Hampi, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in the town of Hampi in Vijayanagara district, east-central Karnataka, India. Hampi predates the Vijayanagara Empire; it is mentioned in the Ramayana and the Puranas of Hinduism as Pampa Devi Tirtha Kshetra.
Hampi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Haridwar.name: Haridwar
Haridwar.title: Haridwar
Haridwar.description: Haridwar (; Hindi: [ɦəɾɪd̪waːɾ] ; formerly Mayapuri) is a city and municipal corporation in the Haridwar district of Uttarakhand, India. With a population of 228,832 according to 2011 census, it is the second-largest city in the state and the largest in the district.
Haridwar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Hastinapur.name: Hastinapur
Hastinapur.title: Hastinapur
Hastinapur.description: Hastinapur (Hastināpur) is a city in the Meerut district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. Hastinapura is described as the capital of the Kuru kingdom in Hindu texts such as the Mahabharata and the Puranas; it is also mentioned in ancient Jain texts.
Hastinapur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Hyderabad.name: Hyderabad
Hyderabad.title: Hyderabad
Hyderabad.description: Hyderabad is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Telangana. It occupies 650 km2 (250 sq mi) on the Deccan Plateau along the banks of the Musi River, in the northern part of Southern India.
Hyderabad.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Jaipur.name: Jaipur
Jaipur.title: Jaipur
Jaipur.description: Jaipur (Rajasthani: Jayapura, pronounced [ˈd͡ʑɛpʊɾᵊ]) is the capital and the largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan. As of 2011, the city had a population of 3.1 million, making it the tenth most populous city in the country.
Jaipur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Jaisalmer.name: Jaisalmer
Jaisalmer.title: Jaisalmer
Jaisalmer.description: Jaisalmer (IPA: [d͡ʒɛːsəlmeːɾ] ), nicknamed The Golden City, is a city in the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, located 575 kilometres (357 mi) west of the state capital Jaipur, in the heart of the Thar Desert. It serves as the administrative headquarters of Jaisalmer district.
Jaisalmer.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Jammu.name: Jammu
Jammu.title: Jammu
Jammu.description: Jammu () is a city in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir in the Jammu division. It serves as the winter capital of the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
Jammu.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Jodhpur.name: Jodhpur
Jodhpur.title: Jodhpur
Jodhpur.description: Jodhpur (Hindi pronunciation: [ˈd͡ʑoːd̪ʱ.pʊr] ) is the second-largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, after its capital Jaipur. As of 2025, the city has a population of 1.6 million.
Jodhpur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kanchipuram.name: Kanchipuram
Kanchipuram.title: Kanchipuram
Kanchipuram.description: Kanchipuram (IAST: kāñcipuram; [kaːɲdʑipuɾam]), also known as Kanjeevaram or Kancheepuram, is a city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu in the Chennai metropolitan area. Known as the City of Thousand Temples, Kanchipuram is known for its temple architectures, 1000-pillared halls, huge temple towers, and silk saris.
Kanchipuram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kanyakumari.name: Kanyakumari
Kanyakumari.title: Kanyakumari
Kanyakumari.description: Kanyakumari (lit. 'The Unmarried Girl', referring to Devi Kanya Kumari, officially known as Kanniyakumari, formerly known as Cape Comorin) is a town and municipality in Kanyakumari district in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.
Kanyakumari.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Karaikudi.name: Karaikudi
Karaikudi.title: Karaikudi
Karaikudi.description: Karaikudi is a city and municipal corporation in Sivaganga district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the largest city in the district, and the centre of the Karaikudi Metropolitan Area, that forms part of the Chettinad region.
Karaikudi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kochi.name: Kochi
Kochi.title: Kochi
Kochi.description: Kochi ( KOH-chee, Malayalam: [kotˈt͡ʃi] ), formerly known as Cochin ( KOH-chin), is a major port city along the Malabar Coast of India bordering the Laccadive Sea. It is part of the district of Ernakulam in the state of Kerala and is the financial, industial and commercial capital of the state.
Kochi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kullu.name: Kullu
Kullu.title: Kullu
Kullu.description: Kullu (Hindi: [kʊlːuː]) is a municipal council town that serves as the administrative headquarters of the Kullu district of the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It is located on the banks of the Beas River in the Kullu Valley about 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) north of the airport at Bhuntar, Kullu.
Kullu.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumarakom.name: Kumarakom
Kumarakom.title: Kumarakom
Kumarakom.description: Kumarakom is a tourism destination near the city of Kottayam in Kerala, India. It is near the Vembanad Lake, the largest lake in the state of Kerala.
Kumarakom.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumbakonam.name: Kumbakonam
Kumbakonam.title: Kumbakonam
Kumbakonam.description: Kumbakonam or Kudanthai is a city municipal corporation in the Thanjavur district, Tamil Nadu, India. Located 40 km (25 mi) from Thanjavur and 282 km (175 mi) from Chennai and it is the headquarters of the Kumbakonam taluk.
Kumbakonam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumbhalgarh.name: Kumbhalgarh
Kumbhalgarh.title: Kumbhalgarh
Kumbhalgarh.description: Kumbhalgarh also known as the Great Wall of India, is a fortress located on the western range of the Aravalli Hills in Kumbhalgarh, Rajsamand district, Rajasthan, India. Located approximately 48 km (30 mi) from Rajsamand and 84 km (52 mi) from Udaipur, the fort was constructed in the 15th century by Rana Kumbha.
Kumbhalgarh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kurukshetra.name: Kurukshetra
Kurukshetra.title: Kurukshetra
Kurukshetra.description: Kurukshetra (Hindi: kurukṣetra, pronounced [kʊrʊkʃeːtɾə]) is a historical region in India, also known as Dharmakshetra ("Realm of duty") and as the "Land of the Bhagavad Gita". It also refers to the city Kurukshetra, situated in the area and administrative headquarters of Kurukshetra district in the Indian state of Haryana.
Kurukshetra.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Lucknow.name: Lucknow
Lucknow.title: Lucknow
Lucknow.description: Lucknow (/ˈlʌknaʊ/  LUK-now; Hindi: Lakhanaū, pronounced [ˈləkʰnə.uː] ) is a metropolis and the second largest city of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh where it serves as the capital and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district and division. The city had a population of 2.8 million according to the 2011 census, making it the eleventh most populous city and the twelfth-most populous urban agglomeration of India.
Lucknow.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Madurai.name: Madurai
Madurai.title: Madurai
Madurai.description: Madurai is a major city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Madurai district, which is governed by the Madurai Municipal Corporation established on 1 November 1866.
Madurai.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mahabalipuram.name: Mahabalipuram
Mahabalipuram.title: Mamallapuram
Mahabalipuram.description: Mamallapuram (also known as Mahabalipuram) is a town in Chengalpattu district in the southeastern Indian state of Tamil Nadu, best known for the UNESCO World Heritage Site of 7th- and 8th-century Hindu Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram. It is one of the famous tourist sites in India.
Mahabalipuram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mangaluru.name: Mangaluru
Mangaluru.title: Mangaluru
Mangaluru.description: Mangaluru (Kannada: [mɐŋɡɐɭuːru]), formerly called Mangalore ( MANG-gə-lor, -⁠LOR), is a major industrial port city in the Indian state of Karnataka and on the west coast of India. It is located between the Arabian Sea and the Western Ghats about 352 km (219 mi) west of Bengaluru, the state capital, 14 km (8+1⁄2 mi) north of the Karnataka–Kerala border and 297 km (185 mi) south of Goa.
Mangaluru.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mathura.name: Mathura
Mathura.title: Mathura
Mathura.description: Mathura (Braj pronunciation: [mɐ.t̪ʰʊ.ɾäː] ) is a city and the administrative headquarters of Mathura district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is located 162 kilometres (101 mi) south-east of Delhi; and about 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from the town of Vrindavan.
Mathura.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mayiladuthurai.name: Mayiladuthurai
Mayiladuthurai.title: Mayiladuthurai
Mayiladuthurai.description: Mayiladuthurai (formerly known as Mayavaram or Mayuram) is a Special Grade Municipality and the district headquarters of Mayiladuthurai district in Tamil Nadu, India. The town is located 256 km (159 mi) from the state capital, Chennai.
Mayiladuthurai.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Melukote.name: Melukote
Melukote.title: Melukote
Melukote.description: Melukote in Pandavapura taluk of Mandya district, Karnataka, in southern India, is one of the sacred places in Karnataka. It is built on rocky hills, known as Yadugiri, Yaadavagiri or Yadushaila, overlooking the Cauvery valley.
Melukote.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Munnar.name: Munnar
Munnar.title: Munnar
Munnar.description: Munnar (Malayalam pronunciation: [muːn̪ːɐːr]) is a town located in the Idukki district of the southwestern Indian state of Kerala. Munnar is situated at around 1,600 metres (5,200 ft) above mean sea level, in the Western Ghats mountain range.
Munnar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Murudeshwar.name: Murudeshwar
Murudeshwar.title: Murdeshwar
Murudeshwar.description: Murdeshwar or Murudeshwara is a town in Uttara Kannada district in the state of Karnataka, India, and lies on the coast of the Arabian Sea. It contains the world's third tallest Shiva statue, as well as the Murudeshwara Temple.
Murudeshwar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mussoorie.name: Mussoorie
Mussoorie.title: Mussoorie
Mussoorie.description: Mussoorie (Garhwali: [məsuːɾiː]) is a hill station and a municipal board in the Dehradun district of the Indian state of Uttarakhand. It is about 26 kilometres (16 mi) from the state Winter capital Dehradun and 289 km (180 mi) north of the national capital of New Delhi.
Mussoorie.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mysuru.name: Mysuru
Mysuru.title: Mysore
Mysuru.description: Mysore (  my-SOR), officially Mysuru (Kannada: [ˈmaɪˈsuːɾu] ), is a city in the southern Indian state of Karnataka. It is the administrative headquarters of Mysore district and Mysore division.
Mysuru.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nagapattinam.name: Nagapattinam
Nagapattinam.title: Nagapattinam
Nagapattinam.description: Nagapattinam (nākappaṭṭinam, previously spelt Nagapatnam or Negapatam) is a city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Nagapattinam district. The town came to prominence during the period of Medieval Cholas (9th–12th century CE) and served as their important port for commerce and east-bound naval expeditions.
Nagapattinam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nagercoil.name: Nagercoil
Nagercoil.title: Nagercoil
Nagercoil.description: Nagercoil, natively spelt as Nāgarkovil (Tamil: [n̪aːhɐɾkoːʋil], "Temple of the Nāgas", or Nagaraja-Temple), is a City and the administrative headquarters of Kanyakumari District in Tamil Nadu state, India. Situated close to the tip of the Indian peninsula, it lies on an undulating terrain between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea.
Nagercoil.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Namakkal.name: Namakkal
Namakkal.title: Namakkal
Namakkal.description: Namakkal (Tamil: [nɑːməkkəl]) is a city and the headquarters of Namakkal district, Tamil Nadu. It is the first ISO 14001-2004 certified municipality in Asia for environmental management, specifically the provision and maintenance of water supply, solid waste and sewage management, town planning, lighting and other social services.
Namakkal.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nellore.name: Nellore
Nellore.title: Nellore
Nellore.description: Nellore, also spelt as Nelluru, is a city located on the banks of Penna River, in Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh, India. It serves as the headquarters of the district, as well as Nellore Urban mandal, Nellore Rural mandal and Nellore revenue division.
Nellore.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ooty.name: Ooty
Ooty.title: Ooty
Ooty.description: Ooty is a town and seat of the Nilgiris district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located at an altitude of 2,240 m (7,350 ft), in the Nilgiri Mountains, which forms part of the Western Ghats, and is known by the epithet "Queen of hill stations".
Ooty.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pahalgam.name: Pahalgam
Pahalgam.title: Pahalgam
Pahalgam.description: Pahalgam (Urdu pronunciation: [pɛɦɛlɡɑːm]) or Pahalgom (Kashmiri pronunciation: [pəhəlʲɡoːm]) is a town in Anantnag district of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir. It is located on the banks of Lidder River at an altitude of 2,200 m (7,200 ft) in the Vale of Kashmir.
Pahalgam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Palampur.name: Palampur
Palampur.title: Palampur, Himachal Pradesh
Palampur.description: Palampur is a hill station and a municipal corporation situated in the Kangra District in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. Palampur is served by the Palampur Himachal railway station (PLMX), situated in Maranda.
Palampur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Palampur.imageCredit: Sumeet Jain from San Francisco, USA · CC BY-SA 2.0

Palani.name: Palani
Palani.title: Palani
Palani.description: Palani or Pazhani (Tamil: [paɻani]) is a town in Dindigul district of Tamil Nadu state in India. It is located about 60 kilometres (37 mi) west of Dindigul, 106 kilometres (66 mi) south-east of Coimbatore, 122 kilometres (76 mi) north-west of Madurai, 67 kilometres (42 mi) from Kodaikanal.
Palani.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Panipat.name: Panipat
Panipat.title: Panipat
Panipat.description: Panipat () is an industrial city, located 95 km north of Delhi and 169 km south of Chandigarh on NH-44 in Panipat district, Haryana, India. It is famous for three major battles fought in 1526, 1556 and 1761.
Panipat.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Panipat.imageCredit: L&T Panipat Elevated Corridor Limited · CC BY-SA 4.0

Patnitop.name: Patnitop
Patnitop.title: Patnitop
Patnitop.description: Patnitop is a hill station, located, between Ramban Town and Udhampur city in the Udhampur district of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is in located on the Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (which is part of National Highway 44, formerly 1A), 112 km (70 mi) from Jammu, on the way from Udhampur to Srinagar.
Patnitop.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pattadakal.name: Pattadakal
Pattadakal.title: Pattadakal
Pattadakal.description: Pattadakal (Pattadakallu), also called Raktapura, is a complex of 7th and 8th century CE Hindu and Jain temples in northern Karnataka, India. Located on the west bank of the Malaprabha River in Bagalkot district, this UNESCO World Heritage Site is 23 kilometres (14 mi) from Badami and about 9.7 kilometres (6 mi) from Aihole, both of which are historically significant centres of Chalukya monuments.
Pattadakal.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Prayagraj.name: Prayagraj
Prayagraj.title: Prayagraj
Prayagraj.description: Prayagraj (, Hindi: [pɾəjaːɡ.ɾaːd͡ʑ]; ISO: Prayāgarāja), formerly and colloquially known as Allahabad (), is a metropolis in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is the administrative headquarters of the Prayagraj district, the most populous district in the state and 13th most populous district in India and the Prayagraj division.
Prayagraj.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pushkar.name: Pushkar
Pushkar.title: Pushkar
Pushkar.description: Pushkar is an ancient temple town located on the shore of Pushkar Lake near Ajmer City and headquarters of Pushkar tehsil in the Ajmer district in the Indian state of Rajasthan. It is situated about 10 km (6.2 mi) northwest of Ajmer and about 150 km (93 mi) southwest of Jaipur.
Pushkar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Rameswaram.name: Rameswaram
Rameswaram.title: Rameswaram
Rameswaram.description: Rameswaram (IPA: [ɾaːmeːsʋaɾam]; also transliterated as Ramesvaram, Rameshwaram) is a town in the Ramanathapuram district of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is situated on the Pamban Island, separated from mainland India by the Pamban channel and is about 40 kilometres (25 mi) from Mannar Island, Sri Lanka, across the Gulf of Mannar.
Rameswaram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Rishikesh.name: Rishikesh
Rishikesh.title: Rishikesh
Rishikesh.description: Rishikesh or Hrishikesh is a municipal corporation and tehsil of the Dehradun district of the Indian state Uttarakhand. It is situated on the right bank of the Ganges river and is a pilgrimage town for Hindus associated with famous sages and yogis.
Rishikesh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Sarnath.name: Sarnath
Sarnath.title: Sarnath
Sarnath.description: Sarnath (also known as Deer Park, Sarangnath, Isipatana Deer Park, Rishipattana, Migadaya, or Mrigadava) is a town northeast of Varanasi, in Uttar Pradesh, India. It was here that the Buddha gave his first sermon after attaining enlightenment at Bodh Gaya.
Sarnath.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Shimla.name: Shimla
Shimla.title: Shimla
Shimla.description: Shimla, also known as Simla (the official name until 1972), (Hindi: [ʃɪmla] ) is the capital and the largest city of the northern Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. In 1864, Shimla was declared the summer capital of British India.
Shimla.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Srikalahasti.name: Srikalahasti
Srikalahasti.title: Srikalahasti
Srikalahasti.description: Srikalahasti is a town in Tirupati district located in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is a municipality and the revenue division of Srikalahasti mandal and Srikalahasti revenue division.
Srikalahasti.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Srinagar.name: Srinagar
Srinagar.title: Srinagar
Srinagar.description: Srinagar is a city in Indian-administered  Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region. It is the largest city and summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir, which is an Indian-administered union territory.
Srinagar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Srirangapatna.name: Srirangapatna
Srirangapatna.title: Srirangapatna
Srirangapatna.description: Srirangapatna or Srirangapattana is a town and headquarters of one of the seven Taluks of Mandya district, in the Indian state of Karnataka. It gets its name from the Ranganathaswamy Temple consecrated around 984 CE.
Srirangapatna.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Tenkasi.name: Tenkasi
Tenkasi.title: Tenkasi
Tenkasi.description: Tenkasi (Tamil: [t̪eŋɡaːsi]) is a city and the headquarters of the Tenkasi district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
Tenkasi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Thanjavur.name: Thanjavur
Thanjavur.title: Thanjavur
Thanjavur.description: Thanjavur (Tamil: [t̪aɲdʑaːʋuːɾ]), also known as Thanjai, previously known as Tanjore, is a city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the 12th biggest city in Tamil Nadu.
Thanjavur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Thekkady.name: Thekkady
Thekkady.title: Thekkady
Thekkady.description: Thekkady (Malayalam: [t̪eːkːɐɖi]) in Idukki district is a town near Periyar National Park, a tourist attraction in the  Indian state of Kerala. The name Thekkady is derived from the word "thekku" which means teak and "adi" meaning bottom.
Thekkady.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Thiruvananthapuram.name: Thiruvananthapuram
Thiruvananthapuram.title: Thiruvananthapuram
Thiruvananthapuram.description: Thiruvananthapuram (Malayalam pronunciation: [t̪iɾuʋənən̪d̪ɐˈbuɾəm]  tirr-ROO-və-nun-Tə-poor-əm), also known as Trivandrum, is the capital city of the Indian state of Kerala. As of 2011, the Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation had a population of 957,730 over an area of 214.86 km2, making it the most populous city in Kerala.
Thiruvananthapuram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Thiruvarur.name: Thiruvarur
Thiruvarur.title: Thiruvarur
Thiruvarur.description: Thiruvarur (Tamil: [t̪iɾuʋaːɾuːɾ]) also spelt as Tiruvarur is a Municipality in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the administrative headquarters of Thiruvarur district and Thiruvarur taluk.
Thiruvarur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Thrissur.name: Thrissur
Thrissur.title: Thrissur
Thrissur.description: Thrissur (Malayalam: തൃശൂർ, pronounced [triˈʃ(ː)uːr] ), formerly Trichur, also known by its historical name Thrissivaperur, is a city and the headquarters of the Thrissur district in Kerala, India. It is the third largest urban agglomeration in Kerala after Kochi and Kozhikode, and the 21st largest in India.
Thrissur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Tiruchendur.name: Tiruchendur
Tiruchendur.title: Tiruchendur
Tiruchendur.description: Tiruchendur (Tamil: Tiruccentūr [ˈt̪iɾɯtːʃen̪d̪uːr], also jayantipuram, also Thirucheeralaivay) is a town in Thoothukudi district, Tamil Nadu, India. It is home to the Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple, one of the Six Abodes of Murugan.
Tiruchendur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Tiruchirappalli.name: Tiruchirappalli
Tiruchirappalli.title: Tiruchirappalli
Tiruchirappalli.description: Thiruchchirappalli (Tamil pronunciation: [ˈt̪iɾɯtːʃiɾapːaɭːi] ), also known as Tiruchchi or Trichy or historically known as Trichinopoly, is a major tier II city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Tiruchirappalli district. The city is credited with being the most livable and cleanest city in all of Tamil Nadu, as well as the fifth safest city for women in India.
Tiruchirappalli.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Tirunelveli.name: Tirunelveli
Tirunelveli.title: Tirunelveli
Tirunelveli.description: Tirunelveli (Tamil: [tiɾɯnelʋeːli] ), also known as Nellai, is a city and municipal corporation in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located on the southern part of the state, on the west bank of the Thamirabarani River.
Tirunelveli.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Tirupati.name: Tirupati
Tirupati.title: Tirupati
Tirupati.description: Tirupati ( Tiru-pa-ti) is a city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh and serves as the administrative headquarters of Tirupati district. It is known for its significant religious and cultural heritage, being home to the renowned Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, a major Hindu pilgrimage site, as well as other historic temples.
Tirupati.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Tiruvannamalai.name: Tiruvannamalai
Tiruvannamalai.title: Tiruvannamalai
Tiruvannamalai.description: Tiruvannamalai is a city and the administrative headquarters of Tiruvannamalai district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is also a Hindu cultural hub and prominent pilgrimage destination, home to the Arulmigu Annamalaiyar Temple situated along the Annamalai hill, where the monthly Girivalam practice and the annual Karthika Deepam festival attracts thousands.
Tiruvannamalai.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Udaipur.name: Udaipur
Udaipur.title: Udaipur
Udaipur.description: Udaipur (Hindi: IPA: [ʊdəjpʊɾ], ) (ISO 15919: Udayapura) is a city in the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, about 415 km (258 mi) south of the state capital Jaipur. It serves as the administrative headquarters of Udaipur district.
Udaipur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Udaipur.imageCredit: Geri from Biel/Bienne, Schweiz · CC BY-SA 2.0

Udupi.name: Udupi
Udupi.title: Udupi
Udupi.description: Udupi (Kannada: [uɖupi]) is a city in the Indian state of Karnataka. It is the administrative headquarters and taluka of Udupi district, and one of the fastest-growing cities in Karnataka.
Udupi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Varanasi.name: Varanasi
Varanasi.title: Varanasi
Varanasi.description: Varanasi (Hindi pronunciation: [ʋaːˈɾaːɳəsi], also Benares, Banaras Hindustani pronunciation: [bəˈnaːɾəs]), or Kashi, is a city on the Ganges river in northern India that has a central place in the traditions of pilgrimage, death, and mourning in the Hindu world. The city also has a syncretic tradition of Islamic artisanship that underpins its religious tourism.
Varanasi.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Varkala.name: Varkala
Varkala.title: Varkala
Varkala.description: Varkala is a town and municipality in  Thiruvananthapuram district of the Indian state of Kerala. The Varkala cliff formations found along a 7.5 km (4.7 mi) stretch of the Arabian Sea coast, formed by erosion during the Miocene–Pliocene (23 to 2.58 Ma), has been declared as a National Geological Monument by the Geological Survey of India.
Varkala.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Vellore.name: Vellore
Vellore.title: Vellore
Vellore.description: Vellore (Tamil: ['ʋeːluːɾ] WAY-loor), also spelled Velur, is a city and municipal corporation in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the administrative headquarters of Vellore district.
Vellore.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Vrindavan.name: Vrindavan
Vrindavan.title: Vrindavan
Vrindavan.description: Vrindavan (pronounced [ʋɾɪnˈdɑːʋən] ; IAST: Vṛndāvana), also spelt Vrindaban and Brindaban, is a historic city in the Mathura district of Uttar Pradesh, India. It is located in the Braj Bhoomi region and holds religious significance for Hindus, who believe that Krishna, one of the main Gods in Hinduism, spent most of his childhood in this city.
Vrindavan.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Warangal.name: Warangal
Warangal.title: Warangal
Warangal.description: Warangal (Telugu: [ʋɐrɐŋɡɐl] ), also known as Orugallu, is a city in the Indian state of Telangana and the district headquarters of Warangal district. It is the second largest city in Telangana with a population of 811,844 per 2011 Census of India, and spreading over an 406 km2 (157 sq mi).
Warangal.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Yadadri.name: Yadadri
Yadadri.title: Yadadri Bhuvanagiri
Yadadri.description: Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district  is a district in the Indian state of Telangana. The administrative headquarters is located at Bhuvanagiri which is also known as Bhongiri.
Yadadri.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
